title: Switch to a work item dialog from the preview panel
description:
Get a larger view of your work items without leaving your list. You can now open a work item in a dialog directly from the preview panel in List view and global search. From this dialog, you can navigate between work items using arrow buttons or keyboard shortcuts. Open a list view or perform a global search in Jira.
	Select a work item to open it in the preview panel.
	Select the expand button in the preview panel to open the work item in a modal.
